title: News Producer
description: Produce daily news segments and coordinate field reporters. Responsible for content planning, script writing, and production coordination. Work closely with journalists and editors to create compelling news stories.
requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Journalism or related field
Minimum 3 years experience in television production
Strong writing and editing skills
Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines
Knowledge of current affairs and media ethics

title: Video Editor
description: Edit video content for news and entertainment programs using professional editing software. Work with producers to create engaging visual content for broadcast and digital platforms.
requirements:
Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects
Minimum 2 years video editing experience
Creative mindset and attention to detail
Portfolio of previous work required
Ability to work flexible hours

title: Marketing Manager
description: Develop and execute marketing strategies to increase viewership and brand awareness. Manage social media campaigns, advertising, and promotional activities.
requirements:
MBA preferred or Bachelor's in Marketing
Minimum 5 years experience in media marketing
Strong analytical and strategic planning skills
Experience with digital marketing tools
Excellent communication skills

title: Camera Operator
description: Operate cameras for studio and field productions. Work with directors to capture high-quality video footage for various programs.
requirements:
Technical training in camera operation
Minimum 1 year experience
Knowledge of camera equipment and lighting
Ability to work in fast-paced environments
Physical fitness for field work

title: Journalist/Reporter
description: Research, investigate, and report on news stories. Conduct interviews, gather information, and write articles for broadcast and online platforms.
requirements:
Degree in Journalism or Communications
Excellent writing and reporting skills
Ability to work under tight deadlines
Strong research and interview skills
Ethical journalism standards
